bank: EYES AND EARS -- THE ORDER THIS LANE CHECKS IN
why_an_order: This lane owns ten instruments. Run in any order they make a pile of numbers; run in a reviewer's order they make a REPORT, because each step is only worth doing if the one before it passed. Nobody checks a palette on a screen that never rendered.
rule_zero: A ZERO NEEDS A POSITIVE CONTROL. Before believing that a thing did not happen, prove the counter can move. This lane published two zeros today that were blind counters, not silence, and the rule exists because of them.

the_art_order.instrument: gates/eyes_gate.js (a live canvas over 200x400 in any frame)

the_art_order.asks: shrink it: does it still read? the thumbnail test a director does first
is contrast doing the work, or is colour carrying it
nothing off the edge, no text wider than its box
detail order, colour density, saturation, value band, grain, light
orphans, banding, jaggies, mixed resolutions, the key
does it belong to this world; is this the same game two taps apart

the_sound_order.asks: did anything render at all -- WITH A POSITIVE CONTROL
true peak and clipping, before anything else
on a phone speaker: level, and what survives above 500 Hz
does it read as the material it is meant to be
against the music and the steps, and in mono
the_sound_order.instrument: NOBODY YET -- E5 gap 10, the mix has never been metered

grounding: The art order is how directors actually review: the squint and thumbnail test first (does the focal point read at any size), then VALUE before colour (strip the colour: if it all blurs together, saturation was carrying the image), then silhouette, then colour, then detail. The sound order is the broadcast QC pass: clarity, no clipping at true peak, the bed never masking what matters, effects calibrated to the thing they sit under, loudness in the window, stereo image with no phase issues, and mono fold-down intelligibility.
